title: One variant by hand

blocks.what_we_do: Calculate a simple carrier odds ratio for one variant on an [autosome](../docs/glossary.md#autosome) (a non-sex chromosome). The variant passed all quality control.
blocks.why: The [odds](../docs/glossary.md#odds) of an outcome are the number of people with the outcome divided by the number without it. An odds ratio (OR) compares the odds in two groups. An OR of 1 means the odds are equal. A carrier has at least one copy of an [allele](../docs/glossary.md#allele) (one version of the variant). We compare carriers of the allele named in the exported column with non-carriers. This is a teaching calculation. It is not the additive, adjusted model that the real GWAS uses. The counted allele matters: if you count the other allele, the contrast changes.
blocks.you_need: The full cohort from 5.7 and the retained variant 9:96426973:A:G.
blocks.command:
```{r s6-1}
report <- guided_path(cfg, "6.1", "example")
run_plink(cfg, c("--pfile", guided_path(cfg, "5.7"), "--snp", "9:96426973:A:G", "--export", "A", "--out", report))
x <- read.table(paste0(report, ".raw"), header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
dose <- as.numeric(x[[7]])
psam <- guided_table(paste0(guided_path(cfg, "5.7"), ".psam"))
case <- psam$Disease[match(x$IID, psam$IID)] == "2"
tab <- table(case = case, carrier = dose > 0)
print(tab)
carrier_or <- tab["TRUE", "TRUE"] * tab["FALSE", "FALSE"] / (tab["FALSE", "TRUE"] * tab["TRUE", "FALSE"])
print(c(counted_allele_column = names(x)[7], carrier_odds_ratio = carrier_or))
guided_artifact_checkpoint(cfg, "6.1", paste0(report, ".raw"), parent = "5.7")
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

```sh
bin/plink2 --pfile results/guided/s5-7_state --snp 9:96426973:A:G --export A --out results/guided/s6-1_example --threads 2 --memory 2048
```

`--snp` selects one variant by its exact current ID. `--export A` writes the [dosage](../docs/glossary.md#dosage) of the named allele: the number of copies, 0, 1 or 2, with missing values kept separate. R then builds the 2-by-2 carrier table. `--pfile` reads the final genotype files. `--out` sets the prefix of the report files. `--threads 2` limits PLINK to two worker threads. `--memory 2048` gives PLINK 2048 MiB (about 2 GB) of working memory.
blocks.expected_result:
A table of carriers and non-carriers in the retained cohort, and a finite odds ratio. Read the direction of the odds ratio with the allele in the exported column. This allele is not always the one that raises risk.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks passed on Windows; main test counts and significance match the expected values.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the input file named in the message and the previous step. Keep the command and the console log. Do not use files from a different version of the dataset. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.quick_check:
An OR of 2 means that the probability of disease doubled. Is this statement generally correct?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

No. Odds and probability are different things. An odds ratio is usually not the same as a risk ratio.

</details>
